$comment: One ELEMENT of a vector register, to and from a general register, in a standalone aarch64 `.s` — `umov`, `ins` and their `mov` aliases at the byte, halfword, word and doubleword sizes, with two re-reads that require `ins` to keep the lanes it does not write (D-ASM-DIALECT-GAPS-A-REFERENCE-ASSEMBLER-ACCEPTS). The P68 round-7 base refused the first `v1.b[1]` at its parser. ✔MEASURED 2026-09-21: aarch64-linux-gnu-gcc (GNU as 2.42) and clang 18.1.3 (its integrated assembler) both assemble it, and both binaries exit 42 under qemu-aarch64. Exit 11-16 names the check that went wrong. ★ The `release` arm, scoped honestly: assembly text forms no MIR, so no pipeline can transform it — the arm pins that `--config=release` still produces a working binary from it.
